description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Izzet Chronarch
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Izzet Chronarch
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
